title: Too many issues, do not subscribe
body:
Latest update 06 Jan 26
TLDR: It’s a scam!!!

They sneakily changed their developer response later(Shows their lack of integrity). The previous reply required a proof of purchase and now they changed the response to require me to email them to restore my purchase. This shows they have no idea who has subscribed to them. Do not fall for their scam!



Sep 2025:
Do not subscribe as you may lose your subscription and
they require proof of purchase as well as to restore subscription.  Ie. Your lifetime subscription is as good as gone. (Refer to developer response)


Latest update 12 Mar 25
Premium subscription still not restored. 

Updated  27 Sep 24

Developer replied saying that they do restore purchases but there are 4 issues. 

1. You’re required to email them with your personal email, thus breaching privacy to get back your subscription. 

2. It is hard to believe that they’d have to handle thousands of individual email requests to restore each individual account. 

3. They lack the robustness to be able to restore your purchases without you contacting them.  

4. They took more than a year to reply my feedback. Obviously they’re too busy to maintain their app. 

Subscribe and pay at your own risk. I will not reveal my personal email for this simple issue. 

An update: I previously had a premium subscription but with the latest update, I couldn’t restore the premium subscription. Beware when subscribing with them. They’ll change the terms midway even though you already paid for it. First and foremost, the app crashes for the past few updates. The only way I got it resolved was to delete and re install but it doesn’t allow me to restore all my previous data. This means I lost YEARS of progress and database. The irony is, if you want to track your habits, steer clear from this app as there is a chance that: 1) you’d lose all data at some point 2) when you do have a lot of data and display streaks, it lags and takes a long time to log your habits 3) Up till now, I’ve been sending in reviews but there hasn’t been any replies by the developers to address the issues. TLDR; DO NOT SUBSCRIBE TO THIS APP. Ps: you can look at the latest reviews. Most of them have been highlighting so many issues.

title: Hear me out!
body:
I love both Done and Tally, beautiful and functional design interface! However their main functions really overlap, and it’s quite annoying to switch between the two just for the little added benefit each provide (Done: visually displayed progress to help enforcing the habit; Tally: the no-goal count function). 
Would be SO awesome if they’re combined into one neat package; I honestly wouldn’t mind paying extra for that lil gem!

title: Minimal aesthetic and great value
body: This app is great for those who love a minimalist aesthetic. It focuses on doing a few things right and fits nicely into a workflow with a productivity app like Things 3. My only wish is that they would offer a desktop/web version or a way to make your current goals appear as a live screen saver on your laptop.
